5800: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead in a Y.
Turn your thumbs toward the ceiling.
Lift your arms off the floor, squeezing your shoulder blades.
5801: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang from the bar with a false or overhand grip.
Pull explosively, bringing your chest to the bar.
Lean over the bar and press yourself up to straight arms.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.
5803: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs until level with your body.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
5805: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet wide apart.
Lift your hips to the top of a bridge.
Pulse your hips up and down in small, controlled movements.
5810: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent, pressing your foot toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower and repeat, then switch legs.
5813: Set the pad at hip height and hook your heels under the rollers.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise yourself until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.
5814: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance with elbows bent.
Press the handles up and forward in an arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands meet.
5815: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip one handle at chest level.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your set.
5816: Lie on your side on a flat bench with a dumbbell in the top hand.
Bring the weight to your chest.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to the chest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
5817: Lie on your side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the top hand.
Keep your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping your elbow still.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your set.
5818: Hold a light weight in each hand with thumbs pointing up.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to about shoulder height.
5819: Hold light dumbbells with your thumbs pointing down.
Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Raise your arms diagonally forward to shoulder height.
5820: Lie face down on a bench or floor with light dumbbells hanging.
Turn your thumbs to the ceiling.
Raise your arms out diagonally into a Y.
5821: Kneel next to a cable with your elbow at shoulder height and bent 90 degrees.
Hold the handle and brace your core.
Rotate your forearm upward until it points to the ceiling.
Reverse the movement slowly and switch sides.
5822: Lie face down with arms stretched overhead in a Y.
Lift your arms, squeezing your shoulder blades.
5823: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand tall.
Step forward and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot and bring the back leg forward into the next step.
Continue alternating legs for the set distance.
5825: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Step one foot back behind you.
Lower until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
5837: Anchor the band low and face away from it, holding the band between your legs.
Step forward until you feel tension, feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes and drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your arms relaxed and straight.
5843: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.
5844: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.
5846: Stand tall with your hands behind your head.
Lift one knee and rotate your torso.
Bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
5853: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
5854: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the balls of your feet on a step if you like.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
5855: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and hinge to grip it.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up to your shoulder.
Brace your core and press the bell overhead.
Lock out your arm with the bicep near your ear.
Lower to the shoulder, then back to the floor, and switch sides.
5856: Sit with your legs apart and a kettlebell in one hand.
Rest your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the kettlebell up toward your shoulder.
5857: Stand holding a kettlebell by the handle with both hands or one.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
5858: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides until the elbows touch the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the weights back up.
5859: Stand tall holding a kettlebell with both hands by the sides of the handle.
Raise the kettlebell to shoulder height.
5860: Hold a kettlebell by the horns with both hands overhead.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms until they are straight.
5861: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
5862: Sit with your forearm on your thigh, palm up, holding a kettlebell.
Curl your hand up toward you.
5863: Stand tall with a kettlebell held overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending the elbow.
Straighten your arm back to the top.
5864: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms hanging.
Hinge back at your hips and swing your arms between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and stand tall.
Let your arms float up to chest height.
5865: Stand with your feet wide and squat down.
Jump up, bringing your feet together mid-air.
Land softly in a narrow stance and squat.
Jump again, landing back in the wide stance.
Keep your chest up and move at a steady pace.
5866: Place your feet on a bench and your hands close together under your chest.
Form a diamond with your thumbs and index fingers.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Push back up to straight arms.
5867: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a kettlebell in each hand.
Row one kettlebell toward your hip.
Rotate your torso slightly as you pull.
Lower the weight and repeat on the other side.
5873: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
5874: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar behind your head with elbows bent.
Extend your arms forward and up.
5876: Hold the handles and lean forward with a straight body.
Start with your arms overhead and elbows bent.
Extend your arms, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause when your arms are straight.
5879: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Hold a kettlebell in your top hand pointing up.
5880: Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
At the top, rise onto your toes for a calf raise.
Lower your heels and repeat with control.
5881: Sit on the floor, place your hands behind you and lift your hips off the ground.
Keep your hips high and your core braced.
Step with opposite hand and foot to move forward.
Walk for several steps, then go backward.
Keep your head neutral and your arms steady.
5882: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped above one shoulder.
Squat down while chopping your hands diagonally toward the opposite knee.
Rotate through your trunk and let your back foot pivot.
Stand up as you swing your arms back up.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
5883: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip at thigh level.
Curl the bar up to your shoulders without swinging.
Press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head, keeping your upper arms still.
Extend, bring the bar back to the front and lower it under control.
Use a light weight to keep your form tidy.
5884: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides.
Curl both dumbbells up to shoulder height.
Press them overhead until your arms are straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the weights behind your head.
Extend your arms, then bring the dumbbells back to your shoulders and down to your sides.
Keep your torso still and choose a manageable weight.
5885: Sit on the floor with your legs crossed and each foot resting on the opposite thigh if comfortable.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Inhale slowly through your nose and fill your belly and chest.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and breathe steadily for 1-2 minutes.
5886: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding a kettlebell in both hands.
Push your hips back and lower the bell toward the outside of one foot.
Rotate your torso slightly as you reach, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and unwind.
Repeat to the same side, then switch.
5887: Start in downward dog with hands shoulder-width apart.
Press your hands into the floor and lengthen your spine.
Lift one leg straight up behind you, keeping your hips square.
5888: Start in a high plank with your wrists under your shoulders.
Shift slightly forward on your toes.
Bend your elbows straight back and lower to elbow height.
Keep your body in one line and your elbows near your ribs.
Hold briefly, then press back up.
5889: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and slightly apart.
Let your arms rest by your sides with palms up.
Close your eyes and let your whole body soften.
Roll to your side and sit up gently.
5890: Sit with your legs crossed and stack one shin on top of the other.
Flex your feet to protect your knees.
Sit tall, then hinge forward over your shins.
Swap which leg is on top and repeat.
5891: Step one foot back into a long lunge with your back heel lifted.
Bend your front knee to about 90 degrees over your ankle.
Sweep your arms overhead and stand tall.
5892: Start in a low lunge with your back knee down or lifted.
Walk your front foot to the outer edge of your mat.
Place both hands inside the front foot.
5894: Sit comfortably cross-legged, with hips slightly higher than your knees.
Lengthen your spine and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your knees.
Close your eyes and settle into easy breathing.
5895: Sit tall in a comfortable position and relax your shoulders.
Rest your hands on your lap.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Breathe out slowly and notice the pause.
5896: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart.
Spread your toes and press evenly through both feet.
Lengthen your spine and draw your shoulders back and down.
Let your arms hang with palms forward.
5897: Start on hands and knees with your hips over your knees.
Walk your hands forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your hips high above your knees.
Rest your forehead down and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Walk your hands back to return.
5898: Step one foot back with both feet facing forward.
Keep both legs straight and your hips square.
Hinge forward from your hips with a long back.
5899: Stand and sink your hips back into a chair pose.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist and hook one elbow outside the opposite knee.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your knees together.
Untwist and repeat on the other side.
